description: For maps \(f:A\to B\), \(g:B\to C\), and \(h:C\to D\), composition is associative: \((h\circ g)\circ f=h\circ(g\circ f)\).
signature:
Function.comp_assoc.{u₁, u₂, u₃, u₄} {α : Sort u₁} {β : Sort u₂} {φ : Sort u₃} {δ : Sort u₄} (f : φ → δ) (g : β → φ)
  (h : α → β) : (f ∘ g) ∘ h = f ∘ g ∘ h
